summary: Each edition was reviewed independently against all four paragraphs of the selected Greek. Both preserve the understanding–repentance argument, cessation of evil, lavish good, self-humbling and affliction, the working reading of II.3, and the conditional promise involving keeping and walking in the commandments. The simplified edition’s sentence divisions do not materially change these relationships. The bracketed supplement is distinguished from preserved text, and the notes accurately disclose the alternatives and evidentiary limits described in the supplied project reports. Contextual repentance terminology conforms to current policy. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to this working source and the supplied disclosures; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, certify the reported editions, or establish exhaustive collation.
